name: A Fishy Peril
summary: In Goldshire, A Fishy Peril begins with reports of murlocs moving inland through the waterways. Remy "Two Times" asks travelers to alert Marshal Dughan, whose guards are already stretched thin.

sections.title: A Plea from the East
sections.body: Remy "Two Times" grows uneasy over a new threat while seeking business in Goldshire. Murlocs are creeping up the streams and into inland shallows, disrupting fishing and menacing innocent travelers. Remy fears the local guard is overlooking a danger that is still growing, so he asks passersby to carry word to the heart of the township.

sections.title: A Strained Garrison
sections.body: Marshal Dughan hears the report in Goldshire but remains skeptical. He is charged with protecting the realm while royal forces are stretched thin elsewhere, and Riverpaw gnolls and Defias highwaymen already demand his attention. With no confirmed military intelligence, he will not divert his scarce men to pursue rumors of fish-men in the eastern streams.

faq.q: Who gives the quest A Fishy Peril?
faq.answer: Remy "Two Times", a merchant from Redridge, gives the dispatch in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why is Remy "Two Times" worried about murlocs?
faq.answer: Remy has seen murlocs swimming up the rivers of eastern Elwynn, driving away local fish and attacking travelers along the waterways.

faq.q: Why won't Marshal Dughan send troops immediately?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan considers the reports unverified. His garrison is occupied by gnoll attacks and organized banditry, and he cannot commit soldiers without formal scout reports.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: what comes after a fishy peril
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan follows up with Further Concerns, seeking reliable confirmation from scouts before committing royal resources to the east.

faq.q: Where does the player turn in A Fishy Peril?
faq.answer: You deliver the report to Marshal Dughan just outside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: What larger threat are the murlocs part of in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Murlocs appear primitive and erratic, yet their spread into inland lakes such as Stonecairn Lake and Crystal Lake threatens rural trade and agriculture alongside gnoll and bandit attacks.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this dispatch shows the strain on Stormwind's home guard and the township's reliance on independent adventurers to investigate rumors.
As a human, you see eastern waterways close to home turn into dangerous hunting grounds for aquatic beasts.
